next.reason: 1985 GR6 unconditionally: 'the information in the area referenced by identifier-1 is available'. §2023:14.9.35.4 GR10 adds 'provided that identifier-1 is not one or part of one of the record descriptions subordinate to the file-description'. 1985 SR1 refused identifier-1 sharing storage with record-name-1 (every record of the FD shares the record area); 2023 lifts that (§2023:14.9.35.4 GR7 NOTE 2 treats sharing as overlap), so a program 1985 refused is accepted and gets no availability guarantee: a case removed.
